class.name: VoxelData
class.description: VoxelData holds a field of 4D voxel data. For each grid point in the region where it is defined, it gives a material and (if applicable) some surface data.

method.name: get_density
method.description: Returns the density of the voxel at the given coordinates: how far the voxel's center is from the nearest surface, from 0 at the surface to 255, whether the voxel is inside solid material or air. Returns 0 for undefined voxels.

method.name: is_voxel_defined
method.description: Returns whether the voxel data at the given coordinates is defined.
